set -eu
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import sys, pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts_path, layout_path, gene_map_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
out_de, out_sig, out_bg = sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5], sys.argv[6]

counts_raw = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
layout = pd.read_csv(layout_path)
gene_map = pd.read_csv(gene_map_path, sep='\t')

col_to_sample = {col: col.replace('_', '-') for col in counts_raw.columns}
sample_to_group = dict(zip(layout['SampleID'], layout['Group']))

keep = (counts_raw > 10).any(axis=1)
counts_filt = counts_raw.loc[keep]
print(f"After pre-filter: {counts_filt.shape[0]} genes", file=sys.stderr)

targets = {'DMSO', 'DMSO_Serum_starvation', 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50', 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h'}
tcols, tmeta = [], []
for col in counts_filt.columns:
    g = sample_to_group.get(col_to_sample[col])
    if g in targets:
        tcols.append(col)
        tmeta.append({'SampleID': col_to_sample[col], 'Group': g})

counts_sub = counts_filt[tcols]
meta_df = pd.DataFrame(tmeta, index=counts_sub.columns)
print(f"Subset: {len(tcols)} samples", file=sys.stderr)

counts_sub_T = counts_sub.T
nonzero = counts_sub_T.sum(axis=0) > 0
counts_sub_T = counts_sub_T.loc[:, nonzero]
print(f"Count matrix shape (samples x genes): {counts_sub_T.shape}", file=sys.stderr)

dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts_sub_T, metadata=meta_df, design="~Group")
dds.deseq2()

stat_res = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=["Group", "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50", "DMSO"])
stat_res.summary()
results = stat_res.results_df
print(f"DE results: {results.shape[0]} genes", file=sys.stderr)

ensg2sym = dict(zip(gene_map['ENSG'], gene_map['gene_name']))
results['gene_symbol'] = results.index.map(lambda x: ensg2sym.get(x, x))
results.index.name = 'ENSG'

results.reset_index().to_csv(out_de, index=False)

sig_mask = (results['padj'] <= 0.05) & (results['log2FoldChange'].abs() >= 0.5) & (results['baseMean'] >= 10)
sig = results.loc[sig_mask]
sig_syms = pd.unique(sig['gene_symbol'].dropna().values)
with open(out_sig, 'w') as f:
    for g in sig_syms:
        if g and str(g) != 'nan':
            f.write(f"{g}\n")
print(f"Significant genes: {len(sig_syms)} symbols", file=sys.stderr)

bg_syms = pd.unique(results['gene_symbol'].dropna().values)
with open(out_bg, 'w') as f:
    for g in bg_syms:
        if g and str(g) != 'nan':
            f.write(f"{g}\n")
print(f"Background genes: {len(bg_syms)} symbols", file=sys.stderr)
